projects.description: DRIVER XP – Game Ever HOME ABOUT US PORTFOLIO CONTACT CAR DRIVER XP Video Game Young people are the main fatalities in road accidents. Statistically, they are injured three times more than adults and are the cause of most of them. For reference, in 2019 more than 3,000 boys and girls lost their lives in traffic accidents. Faced with this problem, Michelin reaffirms its commitment to promoting sustainable and, above all, safe mobility . Under this premise, the company presents Car Driver XP, a road safety awareness campaign with the aim of generating a change in behavior in young people when driving. The proposal is based on this online video game , in which the participants must overcome a series of challenges and handling obstacles to become winners. This game received the « CSR Distinction . Communicative Social Responsibility» in 2020.

projects.description: DE VIVOS – Game Ever HOME ABOUT US PORTFOLIO CONTACT BASTA DE VIVOS 2D Animation Chevrolet presents the new #BastaDeVivos campaign that focuses on the famous «Creole liveliness» and how it manifests itself in unfair practices in urban traffic by those who believe they are «more alive» than others. The campaign raises the need to change this widespread characteristic among some Argentines, first of all on the street, in order to achieve a more orderly and safer urban transit. The campaign was created by the agency Commonwealth McCann and totally worked from the digital realm for the new Chevrolet Tracker, the recently launched compact SUV with renewed design, greater connectivity and more safety equipment.

projects.description: COCO – Game Ever HOME ABOUT US PORTFOLIO CONTACT CAPITÁN COCO 2D Animation Will is a boy of about 26 years of age and Coco is a tropical fruit obtained from the coconut tree, a simple and ordinary palm tree. The two meet on a completely deserted and mysterious island paradise. They spend their time recreating their old life, shaping the rustic atmosphere and animating beings of their interest. The show revolves around the experiences caused by Will and Coco, which turn into fantastic and strange situations. Their main motivations are to have fun, eat and sleep. Will possesses the knack for getting into all kinds of trouble, while Coco, a somewhat more mature fruit, acts like a seasoned naval captain taking advantage of his innocent young companion.

Get ready for an overdose of optimism in the scariest world, with all kinds of monsters who know how to see the glass half full of blood! A band that knows that to succeed in this society, we must trust and accept ourselves as and give a hand to whoever needs it … As long as you can find one! Put aside prejudice. Being unique is the coolest thing!

projects.description: GATITO – Game Ever HOME ABOUT US PORTFOLIO CONTACT EL GATITO Video Game El Gatito (video game) was born from the mini-series with the same name, winner of the First Federal Animation Contest organized by INCAA. The side-scrolling runner-style video game proposes to help the adorable kitten cross an endless desert, collecting fish, using power-ups and avoiding dangers, traveling as far as possible. projects.description: KITTEN – Game Ever HOME ABOUT US PORTFOLIO CONTACT THE KITTEN 2D Animation The INCAA’s Federal Animation Contest award-winning . The Kitten follows the story of an adorable cat that lives on the streets of Buenos Aires. Destiny takes him on a long journey until reaching the arid Patagonian desert. Lost, threatened, and full of fear, he starts to get guided by his instinct in order to survive. He’ll eventually find in the desert the home that the city could never give him. This is an animated miniseries of 4 episodes that can be seen also as a short film .

projects.description: BOO SERIE – Game Ever HOME ABOUT US PORTFOLIO CONTACT MAGGIE BOO SERIES 2D Animation Maggie Boo is an animated comic series set in a fantastic setting of 13 chapters of 12 minutes each, full of jokes, spells and adventures. With endearing characters and a huge constantly expanding universe. Our protagonist is Maggie, a young woman versed in witchcraft, who is often involved in strange situations while interacting with mythical beings, wizards and other creatures. Along with her are her friends Wip and Oku, who will accompany her on most of her journeys through this magical world.
